title: Aerial View of Wonder Fire Burn Scar
description: An aerial view showing the Wonder Fire burn scar on the Shasta-Trinity National Forest in Northern California, March 2, 2026. Documenting the aftermath and environmental footprint of a wildfire incident is essential for monitoring long-term forest recovery, soil stability, and the effectiveness of post-fire restoration efforts. (Forest Service video by Andrew Avitt and Tom Stokesberry)
